description: Minimal capability set for the main and Quick Search windows. The webview gets no filesystem or shell access: every operation goes through DiskPilot's typed commands. Only window dragging, the folder picker dialog, opening external links (scoped to https/http/mailto — the Rust-side open_external command whitelists the same schemes), notifications (scheduled-scan alerts are sent from Rust; the grant covers the plugin's registration) and global-shortcut registration are granted.
